title: Build the resident root image with the donor tools: userland/build.sh system step reproduced on the host (hard-link sysroot from the unpacked rootfs, cryptex trees and dyld cache, launchd moved to launchd.darwin, LaunchDaemons link), tools/apfs/mkapfs.py -z, then tools/apfs/check-image.sh (apfsck at its pinned commit plus the kernel's apfs_lib). Records the real image size against the donor's 2.5 GB claim and the RAM/USB budget.
acceptance: apfsprogs (linux-apfs, GPL-2.0, checker only) is pinned at a full SHA in research/sources.json with its licence notes and verified; no script from it other than the project-reviewed build of apfsck is run.

system.apfs is produced from the IOS-009 unpack tree by the unmodified pinned mkapfs.py; apfsck exits clean and apfs-tool reads every volume back; the size, file count, compressed-versus-raw split and build time are recorded.
The evidence states the figure against the donor's 2.5 GB claim, the 96 MiB recovery slot and the USB budget in NAT-073, without presenting the image as bootable.
